name: KraneShares Global Humanoid Robotics and Physical AI Index ETF

prospectus.objective: The Fund seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the price and yield performance of a specific equity securities index. The Funds current index is the MerQube Global Humanoid Robotics and Physical AI Index (the Underlying Index).
prospectus.strategy: Under normal circumstances, the Fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of the Underlying Index and other instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the Underlying Index. The Underlying Index is an equal weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies involved in the advancement of humanoid and embodied intelligence technology (i.e., robots and drones), including companies in the supply chain solution such technologies. Humanoid and embodied intelligence technologies refer to the AI systems, which can learn and adapt through direct interaction with the environment using sensors or other inputs, that are integrated into physical systems, such as robotics systems and autonomous vehicles. The Underlying Index draws constituents from the following activity groups within The Refinitiv Business Classification (Humanoid Activity Groups): Rare Earth Minerals; Specialty Mining & Metals; Lead Ore Mining; Copper Ore Mining; Nickel Ore Mining; Zinc Ore Mining; Nonferrous Metal Mining; Nonferrous Metal Processing; Specialty Mining & Metals Wholesale; Aerospace & Defense; Industrial Machinery & Equipment; Industrial Components; Industrial Machinery; Ball & Roller Bearings; Testing & Measuring Equipment; Pump & Pumping Equipment; Air & Gas Compressors; Welding & Soldering Equipment; Industrial Process Furnace & Ovens; Fluid Power Cylinder & Actuators; Automatic Vending Machines; Industrial Moulds; Machine Tools; Industrial Valve Manufacturing; Industrial Machinery & Equipment Wholesale; Commercial Equipment; Electrical Components & Equipment; Batteries & Uninterruptible Power Supplies; Wires & Cables; Electrical Components; Lighting Equipment; Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning Systems; Electrical Insulators; Switchgear; Portable Motors & Generators; Electrical Measuring & Testing Instruments; Electric Equipment Wholesale; Auto, Truck & Motorcycle Parts; Automotive Body Parts; Engine & Powertrain Systems; Automotive Batteries; Automotive Systems; Automotive Accessories; Motorcycle Parts & Accessories; Auto & Truck Parts Wholesale; Semiconductors; Electronic Equipment & Parts; Biometric Products; Advanced Electronic Equipment; Display Screens; Electronic Components; 3D Printers; Auto & Truck Manufacturers; Motorcycles & Scooters; Automobiles & Multi Utility Vehicles; Light Trucks; Electric (Alternative) Vehicles; Luxury Vehicles; Auto & Truck Wholesale; and Integrated Hardware & Software. From the companies in the Humanoid Activity Groups at each reconstitution date (Universe), the Underlying Index ranks companies that, among other things, meet certain minimum market capitalization and liquidity requirements (as measured by the one and six month average daily value traded), based on a combination of their market capitalization as of five business days prior to reconstitution and their Thematic Relevance Score and selects the top 50 companies as …

Small- and Mid-Capitalization Company Risk. Large Capitalization Company Risk. As such, returns on investments in stocks of large capitalization companies could trail the returns on investments in stocks of small and mid capitalization companies.
